description: This file defines controller functions for handling API requests related to common operations in a Strapi-based application, including retrieving app configuration, generating dummy data, and cleaning the database.

methods.name: getAppConfig
methods.description: Fetches application configuration settings related to user registration and email confirmation from Strapi's plugin store and sends them in the response.

methods.name: generateData
methods.description: Calls a function to generate dummy data and responds with a success message.

methods.name: cleanAllData
methods.description: Calls a function to clean the database and responds with a success message.
